description: Test suite for category boards management in the focalboard server application, including functions for retrieving, creating, and reordering category boards with various user access scenarios.

methods.name: TestGetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Tests for retrieving user category boards with various scenarios including no default category, existing categories, and boards.

methods.name: TestCreateBoardsCategory
methods.description: Tests for creating a boards category with different user access levels, including no boards, implicit access, explicit access, and mixed access.

methods.name: TestReorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Tests for reordering boards within a category, including normal reordering and error cases when not all boards are specified.
